description: React component for managing users in an administrative dashboard, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting users with API interactions.

methods.name: useToast()
methods.description: Custom hook for displaying transient toast notifications.

methods.name: fetchUsers
methods.description: Fetches the list of users from the backend API and updates state.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the user form fields for creating or editing a user.

methods.name: resetForm
methods.description: Resets the user form fields to initial values.

methods.name: submitCreate(e)
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new user, including optimistic UI updates.

methods.name: submitEdit(e)
methods.description: Saves changes to an existing user, including optimistic UI updates.

methods.name: confirmDelete()
methods.description: Confirms and performs deletion of a user with optimistic update.
